about: Registration check of the HWD NAIP mosaics against the FAA NASR runway ends and displaced thresholds.
sign: resid = NAIP measured - predicted; along + = inward from the named end; across + = right of the direction from the named end toward the opposite end

10R.method: per 61 m segment (30.5 m step): 80th-percentile cross profile of min(R,G,B); peak centroids of the centreline stripe and of both edge stripes; clean segments only (see code); pooled centreline + edge-midpoint samples; robust line fit (3 MAD); per-end value = median of the clean samples within 400 m of that end

10L.method: per 61 m segment (30.5 m step): 80th-percentile cross profile of min(R,G,B); peak centroids of the centreline stripe and of both edge stripes; clean segments only (see code); pooled centreline + edge-midpoint samples; robust line fit (3 MAD); per-end value = median of the clean samples within 400 m of that end

summary.note: one primary marking per runway end / displaced threshold

interyear_phasecorr.method: phase correlation of gradient magnitude, 128x128 px patches (77 m), step 64 px, centres within 150 m of a runway axis; peak >= 0.15
